note: Round 2 hand-written hypotheses: how people-centred and personal posts are written, and milestones round 1 could not separate.

properties.name: credits_others_for_own_success
properties.question: Does the author credit specific other people for helping them reach an achievement of their own?
properties.definition: The author names or describes people who helped them succeed and attributes part of the success to them.
properties.yes_example: I would never have finished this degree without my mentor Sara.
properties.no_example: I finished my degree this week.
properties.hypothesis: Gratitude aimed at helpers may be what drives the thanks effect.

properties.name: spotlights_one_person
properties.question: Is most of the post about one specific person other than the author?
properties.definition: A single named or described individual, not the author, is the main subject of most of the post.
properties.yes_example: Meet Lina, our first engineer, who rebuilt our platform in a month.
properties.no_example: Our engineering team rebuilt the platform in a month.
properties.hypothesis: Single-person spotlights narrow the story-about-individual effect.

properties.name: education_milestone
properties.question: Does the post announce that the author completed a degree, course, or certification?
properties.definition: The author reports finishing an educational program or earning a credential.
properties.yes_example: Officially a certified project manager as of today.
properties.no_example: Here are five courses worth taking this year.
properties.hypothesis: Credential news may collect congratulations like career news.

properties.name: describes_turning_point
properties.question: Does the post describe a specific decision or moment that changed the direction of the author's life or career?
properties.definition: The author identifies one moment or choice as a turning point in their path.
properties.yes_example: The day I turned down that offer changed everything.
properties.no_example: Careers rarely follow a straight line.
properties.hypothesis: Turning points are a sharper form of personal story.

properties.name: ends_with_takeaway_sentence
properties.question: Does the post end with a one-sentence general lesson or takeaway?
properties.definition: The final sentence states a general lesson drawn from what came before.
properties.yes_example: ...Lesson: the best hires are often the ones you almost passed on.
properties.no_example: ...See you all at the next meetup!
properties.hypothesis: Common hook-and-lesson advice; test the ending.

properties.name: live_update_today
properties.question: Does the post describe something happening to the author today or right now?
properties.definition: The post reports an event the author is experiencing on the day of posting, in the present.
properties.yes_example: Today I'm on stage at the Lisbon summit, talking about climate data.
properties.no_example: Last year I spoke at a summit in Lisbon.
properties.hypothesis: Live, in-the-moment updates may feel more personal.

properties.name: self_deprecating_humor
properties.question: Does the author make a joke at their own expense?
properties.definition: The author uses humor that pokes fun at themselves, their skills, or their situation.
properties.yes_example: My code worked on the first try, so naturally I assumed something was broken.
properties.no_example: Our code passed every test on the first try.
properties.hypothesis: Narrower than general humor, which had no effect.

properties.name: looks_forward_with_excitement
properties.question: Does the author say they are excited or looking forward to something coming next?
properties.definition: The author states excitement or anticipation about a future step, event, or chapter.
properties.yes_example: Can't wait to start this next chapter in Berlin.
properties.no_example: This chapter in Berlin is over.
properties.hypothesis: Forward-looking excitement is typical of announcements; test it alone.

properties.name: learned_from_a_person
properties.question: Does the post describe something the author learned from a specific person?
properties.definition: The author attributes a lesson or insight to an interaction with a particular individual.
properties.yes_example: My first manager taught me to always write the agenda first.
properties.hypothesis: Lessons attached to people may avoid the generic-advice penalty.

properties.name: asks_readers_to_share_their_story
properties.question: Does the post ask readers to share a personal experience of their own?
properties.definition: Readers are invited to describe something that happened to them.
properties.yes_example: What was the moment you knew you were in the right job?
properties.no_example: What do you think of the new policy?
properties.hypothesis: Experience questions may work better than opinion questions, which hurt.
